topic.title: Workspace Search View
topic.shortdesc: Use the Search view to find text in project content, review comments, to see all available DITA keys, reusable components and media resources and to insert references to them in the current opened document.

body.p:
The Search view (found inside the project's Personal Workspace) allows you to search for specific components in your project. The view contains the following tabs:
Content - Search for files that contain the given keywords in the entire project.
Reviews - Search for files that contain review comments in the entire project.
- View all available DITA keys and insert references to them.
- View all available DITA reusable elements and insert content references to them.
- View all available media resources (images, audio, video) and insert references to them.
